title: Cross-cohort gut microbiome classification of colorectal cancer: a 10-cohort meta-analysis
description: Code, processed data, and per-sample predictions for a country-aware leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) meta-analysis of gut shotgun metagenomes from 10 colorectal cancer cohorts (n = 1,522 subjects). Demonstrates that species-only Random Forest classifiers significantly outperform joint species-plus-pathway models for CRC detection across cohorts. Includes a robustness battery (seed, threshold, confounder, batch correction), pathway shortlist analysis, and a 4-cohort adenoma classification arm.
